purpose: Teach: 宿舎/華麗/赤外線/右脳/速記/接着/解像度/諸島

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが学生時代、宿舎にお住まいだったのよ
lines.en: You know, Sho — your dad lived in a dormitory when he was a student.
lines.style: Warm, nostalgic tone. Soft opening, like she's sharing a small memory. Gentle pace, almost wondering aloud. Lets the thought settle.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お祭りの華麗な衣装を見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I saw the most beautiful costumes at the festival!
lines.style: Bright, immediate energy. Rushes the opening words with pure excitement. Slight rise at the end — still processing wonder. Sits forward in the voice.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがTVの赤外線リモコンを直して下さったわ
lines.en: And Sho — your dad fixed the TV remote for us.
lines.style: Gentle recall, more present than before. A soft smile underneath. Steady pace. Small lift on the verb, like she's pleased by the memory of his care.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと右脳のパズルやったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I did that right-brain puzzle together!
lines.style: Earnest pride mixing with eagerness. Quick tempo. Emphasis on 'together' — it matters that they shared it. Warm, genuine laugh-ready underneath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが速記の見本を見せて下さったわ
lines.en: Your dad showed us shorthand notes the other day, you know.
lines.style: Soft, reaching backward. Conversational but thoughtful — like she's connecting dots. Slight pause before the verb. Trailing end, inviting his response.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと接着剤で工作したよ
lines.en: And Mei-sis, Dad and I made things with glue — we built stuff!
lines.style: Pure, unselfconscious joy. Accent on the making, the doing. Quick-paced, building energy. Small-child pride at the accomplishment. Breathless finish.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが高解像度のカメラを持ってらしたわ
lines.en: Your dad has this really nice high-resolution camera.
lines.style: Admiring, almost wistful. Warm recognition of someone's quality. Measured pace. Soft opening, lets the detail land gently. Not envying — appreciating.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと諸島の地図を見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, me and Dad looked at a map of all the islands together!
lines.style: Culminating warmth. The crescendo of shared memories. Bright, full voice on the islands part. Sustained energy, like he's sharing his whole heart. Close, intimate tone.
